minimality_argument.zero_new_atomic_lower_bound_for_diagrams: Zero new diagram atoms is unsound unless a previously proved artifact predicate is revoked and reproved over the wider diagram scope. A fresh atom is strictly less destructive because it preserves all exact prior proof claims.
minimality_argument.b2_new_atomic_lower_bound: Zero new B2 atoms is possible only while the existing synthesis matched-quality predicate remains unresolved and no result-bearing matched case population has been frozen or exposed.
